body:
My whole page contains two instantsearch instances. Everything else other than Similar products are in one instance and similar is in another. My first instance basically looks at the url and fetches the route to put some query in filters. On clicking similar product, my route changes, but Instantsearch would not know about it as it sees there is literally no change. Its not a react-instantsearch problem but a react problem. For that react provides cWRP which says if there is a change in the prop, do something that you want to do and update other components. 

So basically I want to know how can I update instantsearch instance to take the new route and render accordingly.
